holdout_once.decision_reason: Adopt only a strict held-out improvement under frozen rule, without Top5 regression and within index cap. No tuning after this measurement.

limitations: Thirty designed scenarios are not representative user traffic. Separate Codex agents supplied viewpoints, not human contributors.
The holdout was scored once after selection; it is now a known regression set. No retuning followed.
Passage generation and production parity were verified on the full corpus and development20 only, not by rescoring the holdout.
Latencies use in-memory fixtures, three passes over development queries, without network/disk acquisition or MCP transport.
Fourteen of thirty unseen questions remain outside Top5; no general search quality guarantee.
